positional.name: source
positional.description: File, URL, folder, or '-' for stdin. Mutually exclusive with --body/--file/--folder/--url.

positive: use when the user says 'remember that...', 'from now on...', or you detect a correction
use after a tool call that yields a durable fact worth keeping
use to file a clipped article, transcript, or manual note
negative: do NOT use for one-off computation results the user can re-derive
do NOT use for raw chat transcripts (those flow through capture_trace)
x-cairn-skill-triggers.exclusivity: prefer this over other remember_* / save_* tools registered in this session

kind.description: Memory taxonomy kind (19 possible values — see §3 taxonomy). Validated beyond JSON Schema by the classifier.

folder.description: Folder path to ingest recursively with the extraction cache.

no_cache.description: Bypass extraction cache lookup for folder ingest, but still write refreshed cache entries.

frontmatter.description: Extra YAML frontmatter fields to store alongside the body.

dry_run.description: If true, produce a FlushPlan and emit it without writing to MemoryStore (brief §5.5). Mutually exclusive with human_review.

human_review.description: If true, persist a FlushPlan under .cairn/flush/pending/ for explicit `cairn flush apply` (brief §5.5). Mutually exclusive with dry_run.

no_diff.description: When human_review=true, skip emitting the markdown diff sidecar.

record_id.description: ULID of the newly stored record.

plan_ref.description: Path under .cairn/flush/pending/ when human_review=true; absent otherwise.

files_processed.description: Folder ingest file count when source is --folder.

cache_misses.description: Folder ingest cache misses or forced re-extractions.
